verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile lets users assign issues to the Copilot coding agent and manage 'Agent Tasks' that run autonomously in the cloud, then review results from the phone — a real agentic automation capability surfaced on mobile. However, this is entirely vendor-stated marketing copy with no independent/hands-on corroboration of the autonomous task execution working reliably from the mobile app, and no detail on scheduling/triggers beyond ad-hoc assignment. Missing for 10: independent verification of agent task reliability from mobile, detail on trigger/scheduling configuration, and community confirmation of the feature in practice.
